It sounds incredibly frustrating to put in so much effort at the gym and with your diet, only to feel like you aren't seeing the results you want. It is completely understandable that you are exploring new options after a difficult winter. 

Because weight management involves both physical and emotional factors, talk therapy and medical support often work well together rather than being an either-or choice. Therapy is wonderful for exploring your relationship with food and the emotional toll of dieting. However, I cannot give medical advice or determine if a weight-loss medication is right for your specific history. The best step is to have an open conversation with your primary care doctor. They can evaluate your health, explain how these new prescriptions work, and help you decide if combining medical support with your ongoing therapy and gym routine is the safest and most effective path forward for you.
